## bijection_verdict

**PASS** — every atom of `tire_ext_service_rotation_charge` and `tire_ext_flat_repair_charge` (baselines, all 9 factor ladders in full incl. compound conditions and method tiers, the one prerequisite, all overwrites) and of the base policies governing their subjects is entailed at the same strength; retired surface borne and marked; nothing unsourced. First revision.

Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict): (1) the `tire_installation_charges` tpms clause is retired by an overwrite whose replaced_by text itself presumes "the sensor kits charged when a set is installed" remain separate entries, leaving no in-force rule that books them — source-side incoherence rendered faithfully; (2) the `*_included` lifetime parameters remain published as "included for life" while the clauses giving them effect are retired — source-side, carried as the source has them.
